svg.text: R0 on AWS — what runs where
ap-south-1 (Mumbai) · one VPC per environment · every connector is a real network path, and there are only two reverse proxies on it
the only internet entry point — not in the VPC
ns: shared-platform · one deployment for every line of business
W0b + W1 — configuration and the journey spine
W2 – W4 — the gate, the money, the evidence
ns: life-cell · LOB-OWNED — Health gets its OWN copy later
ns: integration · ALL provider traffic leaves here (SC-W3-5)
NAT and IGW only — no workloads
so none of this touches the internet
reached over the VPC endpoints — never the internet
NOT IN R0 — do not provision
each of these is a decision, not an omission
PROXY 2 of 2 — the only one in the VPC
1SB and the PG allowlist THIS EIP
MSK / Kafka — the outbox covers R0
A second live region — DR is warm standby
Cognito — Keycloak is the R0 IdP
Egress — by the NAT Elastic IP
API Gateway is the only public one;
the internal ALB is the only one in the VPC.
Anything else on the path is a defect.
C4 payment callback — see the payment view
